title: A signed-out visitor on /feed sees the real member Feed as Anonymous, with a full-screen join overlay

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14: "This is NOT the actual feed. When a visitor goes to the feed, I want them to see the actual feed with their account as Anonymous. The pop up is a full screen overlay with the Join box in the middle." Replaces the restyled public copy tried as SCAN-886.

detail: Under SITE_DESIGN=frequency a signed-out request for the bare /feed is no longer rewritten to app/(public)/feed-preview: proxy.ts asks lib/nav/anon-feed.ts (anonFeedRoute) and lets it through to app/(main)/layout.tsx, which renders the real FrequencyMembersShell (header, left rail, right rail, tab bar) with an Anonymous stand-in viewer (ANON_FEED_PROFILE: no photo, no stats, no Circles, previewVisitor nav from the access matrix's visitor column, no admin, no Settings) and the public right rail (Get started as the three ways in, Coming up from public events). app/(main)/feed/page.tsx returns FrequencyAnonFeed before the admin client is created: the member Feed body's own greeting, shortcuts, FeedPlanner (Up next and Near you ranked by lib/feed/home-rank.ts with no history), composer, sort lens and PostItem stream, fed only by lib/discover's cookieless public_posts and public_events RPCs (lib/feed/anon-feed.ts). components/frequency/members/feed/anon-join-gate.tsx is a full-viewport modal dialog (the Feed dimmed and blurred behind, the Join box centred: Join free to BETA_CTA_HREF, Log in to /sign-in?next=%2Ffeed, a small Back to Home) that opens 30 seconds after page load (not carried across reloads) and at once on any account-only action: a window capture listener stops every button, field, form submit, Cmd-K and any link outside the public site (anonFeedHrefAllowed in lib/feed/join-gate.ts) before its own handler runs. Public links leave by a full load so they render in their own public chrome. DAWN keeps the preview rewrite; every /feed/* and every other protected path stays protected. The membership presentation now uses the shared JoinPrompt shell also used by public event chat; Feed timing, account-only interception and non-dismissibility remain unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=p=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const px=r('proxy.ts');const lay=r('app/(main)/layout.tsx');const pg=r('app/(main)/feed/page.tsx');const g=r('components/frequency/members/feed/anon-join-gate.tsx')+r('components/frequency/members/join-prompt.tsx');const nav=r('lib/nav/anon-feed.ts');const bad=[];if(!nav.includes('export function anonFeedRoute'))bad.push('no signed-out Feed rule');if(!px.includes('anonFeedRoute(')||!px.includes('!anonFeedShell &&')||!px.includes('!anonFeedInShell(SITE_DESIGN) && !user'))bad.push('the proxy still walls or rewrites a signed-out Frequency Feed');if(!lay.includes('isAnonShellFeed(currentPath')||!lay.includes('ANON_FEED_PROFILE')||!lay.includes('<AnonJoinGate'))bad.push('the member shell does not render the Feed as Anonymous');if(!pg.includes('<FrequencyAnonFeed'))bad.push('the Feed page has no anonymous body');for(const k of ['FEED_PREVIEW_MS','showModal','Join free','Back to Home','BETA_CTA_HREF','anonFeedHrefAllowed'])if(!g.includes(k))bad.push('the join overlay lacks '+k);if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-889: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
